references.authors: Kennon M. Sheldon and Andrew J. Elliot
references.title: Goal striving, need satisfaction, and longitudinal well-being: The self-concordance model
references.usedFor: Alignment of goals with developing interests and core values was associated with sustained effort and goal attainment across three longitudinal datasets.
references.limits: Not evidence that authentic creators necessarily succeed, or that every trend is harmful.

references.authors: Erica R. Bailey, Sandra C. Matz, Wu Youyou and Sheena S. Iyengar
references.title: Authentic self-expression on social media is associated with greater subjective well-being
references.usedFor: Observational association with life satisfaction and within-person experimental differences in mood/positive affect during authentic posting.
references.limits: The experimental within-person comparison did not show a significant life-satisfaction effect; no claim about TikTok reach, earnings or permanent identity change.

visualMethod: Two qualitative editorial card diagrams. All concepts are explained in readable article prose. No measured scores, quantities or effect sizes are charted.
editorialChecks: Complete audio transcript read through 127.88 seconds.
Both languages retain the same claims and research limitations.
Two existing internal article links are localized in each language.
Video metadata describes only the source clip; research and decision diagrams are article extensions.
No invented biographical event, direct quotation, success outcome or diagnosis.
Checked-at date verified using UTC clock on 10 October 2026.

evidenceLimitations: Automatic transcript contains spelling errors, especially the final seconds; no uncertain wording is used as a direct quotation.
Basel is named in the opening; no particular riverfront building or filming address is identified.
The video uses broad warnings about trends and shortcuts; the article does not present those as measured predictions or group-level findings.
Full-motion video review was unavailable; the source review used the original audio, caption, poster and available animated preview.
